answer: Clone-cost design: make standing non-transferable and earned only from capped, verified jobs (max 2 per identity per epoch) scored by rotating 5-juror panels. Buying or cloning a key does not move ledger reputation, so a kernel of empty shells starts at zero. Each extra fake must re-earn capacity through scarce job slots; without that work it cannot claim whisper rewards or hold mesa grading seats for 6 epochs.
